title: The staff ladder
subtitle: Everyone starts as Shadow. You climb by practice, not by time.

roles.name: Shadow
roles.desc: Day one. You watch. You follow. You learn the rhythm before you touch anything.

roles.name: Extra Hands
roles.desc: You know the room. You know the names. Now you help — without leading.
canDo: Set up materials before each block
Help individual kids with writing or drawing
Walk with kids during outdoor time
Take photos of work for documentation
cantDo: Run the opening or closing ritual solo

roles.name: Co-Pilot
roles.desc: You run pieces. The lead is still steering, but you're flying sections of the day.
canDo: Run one activity block solo (lead nearby)
Run the verb guessing game at closing
Handle minor conflicts with the repair script
cantDo: Do the world reveal (that's the lead's moment)

roles.name: Conductor
roles.desc: You can run the room alone. You own the schedule, the rituals, and the relationships.
cantDo: Nothing is off-limits — but always ask for help when you need it. Conductors who never ask burn out.
